svg.text: ESP32-C3 handheld / keypad and MPU wiring
GND Pads 1, 2, 11, 14 and 36–53 (including the exposed pad).
MCU_C1/C2/C3 connect to COL1/2/3 through R20/R21/R22 below.
3 × 3 keypad / nine normally open tactile switches
Band (cathode) toward column. All D1–D9 must be fitted.
PCB: 1N4148W, SOD123. AIM + MODE (S7 + S9) = staff setup.
Supply each row through its own 10 kΩ pull-up. See R11–R13 below.
R8, R9, R10 Each 10 kΩ from SYS_3V3 to STRAP2, STRAP8, BOOT9
Hold BOOT and pulse RESET to enter download mode.
GPIO21 sinks current to turn the LED on. Connect the cathode to LED_K.
JP2 • 3-pad address selector; bridge only one side
C12: 100 nF, FIT from V_MPU to GND. C20: 1 µF, DNP in parallel.
R15/R16: 4.7 kΩ, SDA/SCL → SYS_3V3. DNP if module has pull-ups.
Use these J2 numbers only if they match the actual module pin order.
Check the module regulator/LED current; its VCC input gets 3.3 V.
FIT row pull-ups / DNP filters / six keypad test pads
Leave C13–C15 empty for the first test. Large row capacitors can cause a false key in the next column.
Local 3.3 V supply / close to U2 pad 3
FIT C9/C10. C16: 1206 ceramic reserve, DNP.
Use TP7 / TP8 to measure the ESP supply during radio activity.
Column isolation links and sensor supply link / FIT 0 Ω
R20/R21/R22: 0603 footprints. Keep at 0 Ω for the tested scan behavior.
Use the MINI-1 module land pattern, not a SuperMini board.
Antenna at board edge; no batteries/metal in its keepout.
TP17 EN_RESET • TP18 BOOT9 • TP19 SDA • TP20 SCL
DNP means reserve pads, leave component uninstalled.
Check Fusion ERC, footprints and layout before fabrication.
Rev C • 23 Nov 2026 • ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module • Same net names connect • FIT = install; DNP = leave empty
